plan.notes: Source is AUM's institution-published '4-Year Plan' for Exercise Science, Health Professions Track (file dated 2-3-23 via URL, currently published on aum.edu) — a sample term-by-term schedule including Summer semesters, seeded per the sample-schedule rule. Flight plan header reads 'Major: Kinesiology Degree: Exercise Science (Health Professions Track)'. Generic slots (MATH choice, FINE ARTS, HISTORY, ENGL LIT CORE, HIST or ENGL LIT CORE, Area II or IV Elective, PHED Activity Course, PHED Elective) are choice:true with the flight plan's own wording; specific courses are not assigned by the source. '3|1' lecture|lab pairs (e.g., BIOL 1010/1011) are seeded as a single slot at the combined credit total. Course titles for coded courses are from the official AUM 2023-2024 Undergraduate Catalog course descriptions. The flight plan does not list prerequisites, so no prereq chains are seeded. Extraction note: the PDF text extraction appends unrelated Finance-plan content after the plan's final semester; only the Exercise Science content through Year Four Spring is seeded. Semester credit totals match the flight plan's layout; plan total 120.
